about_the_game:
GRAB YOUR ANCHOR AND LET'S PLAY!

Fio Fizhook is a colorful first person game about a made-up sport. Look out for the fish coming out of the slides, hook them with the anchor and punch them through ramps of all types. Curve the fish and pop the balloons placed around the maps.

THE FIZHOOK CLUB

Is the popular club where this sport is played. Here, all types of places can be found to be enjoyed by Fizhook lovers. Each map have different ramps and obstacles. Get points by popping balloons and complete the club's membership card by getting stamps in each match.

BIRDS, FISH AND SPORT

Fio is a somewhat lazy pelican. One day she gets invited by her friend Fiz to his club; the Fizhook Club. He has apparently made a club about that made-up sport they spent all the day playing as kids. Now Fio will try to get better in the same sport on a more profesional environment.
